racecards.race_name: Bulloughs Cleaning Services Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: On a handy mark but this belated switch to fences needs to have a reviving effect
runners.spotlight: Bumper/Flat/hurdles winner; on a handy mark but his form has dipped in 2026, so this switch to fences needs to have a reviving effect; latecomer to this game, being a 10yo.

quotes.race: Country Food Trust Fakenham Silver Cup Handicap Hurdle
quotes.quote: I would have fancied Paramount in the Imperial Cup but he came here instead and it was a great bit of placing by Charlie Longsdon. Like most of his family he'll improve for a fence - Aidan Coleman, jockey.

quotes.race: Sky Bet UKs No.1 Betting App Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: Parramount was good. He's qualified for the EBF Final and that's the main target. We ran him in a handicap last time and he got beat because he wasn't mentally ready. That's his immaturity, so we decided to come for a novice. I'll try to run him in a handicap before the EBF because he needs to be rated 120-plus. We know he's got ability and he's got more speed than his sister (Snow Leopardess) -      Charlie Longsdon, trainer.

stable_tour.quote: He's an exciting prospect who we'll look to step up in level after winning well last time out. He's a big horse, very leggy, so the plan has always been to go chasing with him eventually. However, I'd like him to get more experience this season before we try that, as he hasn't raced all that much for a six-year-old. 20-11-22

This half-brother to Snow Leopardess has failed to make the first three in only one of his seven races, such is his consistency. He won at Hereford on his penultimate outing and I thought he would win last time out at Taunton on his handicap debut but he got into a slight argument with his jockey and on a sharp track like that he did not get home. He is well handicapped off his current mark of 115 and I have a lot of time for him. He is a very strong-travelling horse, and I am keen to step him up further in trip. I am sure he can win another novice hurdle with his penalty but it will only be when he goes chasing that you will see the real Parramount. 11-01-23

runners.breeder: S C E A Haras Du Hoguenet
runners.comment: Still open to further progress, provided he jumps better than in latest start
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo; solid record until let down by his jumping on last appearance (second chase attempt); had wind surgery (his third) since and now goes in tongue-tie; still open to further progress, provided he avoids errors.

stable_tour.quote: He was always going to be a better chaser than hurdler, and he jumped really nicely on his chase debut last month. He's a two-miler with loads of scope and we might look at something at the Coral Gold Cup meeting. He's off 119 and I'd be very surprised if he's not well above that come the end of the season. Physically, he's not the finished article and, if we mind him, he should be progressive. 23-11-25

A winning hurdler who has gone chasing this season. Unfortunately, he had to be pulled up at Newbury and needed some physio afterwards, but he'll be back in the spring, if not before. He's an athletic sort, the type to improve significantly. I'm expecting him to come to the fore next season. 07-01-26

runners.comment: Consistent maiden; possibilities, provided he takes well to added cheekpieces
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage maiden who has broadly consistent form figures; clear second at Stratford (2m1f) most recently; possibilities dropped further in distance, provided he takes well to added cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Well capable of being involved but he's a fairly exposed maiden
runners.spotlight: Well capable of being involved, as his close third at Catterick on most recent attempt over 1m7f attests; the negative is that he's a fairly exposed maiden whose latest defeat took chase record to 0-8.

runners.comment: Gained last hurdles win off 5lb higher at Wetherby; interesting back here
runners.spotlight: Somewhat similar to Zero Tolerance, being an exposed sort whose chase record is 0-8; the difference is that he's a five-time hurdles winner, most recently off 5lb higher at Wetherby (2m3f) in October; recent form suggests this drop in trip is worth exploring; interesting back here.

racecards.verdict: Attractively weighted SINGAPORE TRIP gets the vote ahead of Gaelic Rambler, whose turn seems near.
racecards.betting_forecast: 7/4 Gaelic Rambler, 11/4 Koapey, 4/1 Singapore Trip, 5/1 Zero Tolerance, 13/2 Parramount

racecards.race_name: Watch Racing TV In Stunning HD Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Drops in class looking attractively treated on the pick of his form for Gordon Elliott
runners.spotlight: Ran poorly in a Pertemps qualifier most recently (second start for new yard) but is interesting off current mark dropped in class, being so attractively treated on the pick of his form for Gordon Elliott.

quotes.race: William Hill Ten Up Novice Chase (Grade 2)
quotes.quote: American Mike is probably one of the horses that makes me scratch my head more than any other. He keeps disappointing me and then he comes back with a good one again. He has obviously a big engine on his day, when he's right, but he's not easy to train. He's in a few of the novice chases at Cheltenham and he could go for an Irish National - Gordon Elliott, trainer.

quotes.race: Race And Stay Irish EBF Beginners Chase
quotes.quote: American Mike finished his race out today, which is the first time he has done it since he was a bumper horse. I'm absolutely thrilled, that meant as much as the rest of the winners. To get him back to where we have him now, I'm thrilled. And Jack has put an awful lot of work into his schooling. He'll go somewhere at Christmas, maybe to the Grade 1 at Limerick - Gordon Elliott, trainer.

quotes.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: American Mike didn't really do much, he was always just in second gear. He was a bit novicey and there is plenty of improvement in him. He will be a 2m4f plus horse - Gordon Elliott, trainer

quotes.race: Weatherbys Champion Bumper (A Standard Open National Hunt Flat Race) (Grade 1) (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: It was a great race and I think we've seen a very good horse there (Facile Vega) but American Mike is very good too. We lost nothing in defeat and they'll be two great horses for the future - Gordon Elliott, trainer.

quotes.race: Future Champions INH Flat Race (Listed Race)
quotes.quote: American Mike did what we expected. He could go to the Dublin Racing Festival but I would say he will go straight to Cheltenham. I think he's a proper horse. Jamie said it was a proper race and they went a proper gallop - Gordon Elliott, trainer.

stable_tour.quote: He ran fine at Newbury first time for me and he's had a wind operation since. He was a big talking horse for Gordon [Elliott]. He's going to have a prep run and then we'll enter him up. He ran in the Grand Annual last year and I'd love to go up in trip and float him round. The engine is still there.  12-02-26

runners.owner: The Posh Pundit Racing Club Limited
runners.comment: Not solid on his chase/hurdles form this year; previously a consistent sort
runners.spotlight: Not solid on his chase/hurdles form this year; previously a consistent sort in this sphere and has a fighting chance off current mark back down in grade, provided he's resurgent.

quotes.race: Thames Materials Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
quotes.quote: It seems to have taken a while. Thank You Ma'am has been second six times and deserves to get his head in front and I'm really chuffed. We were going to go straight over fences next but I'm not sure now because that looked like his best performance. He stays well but I'd say he doesn't want bottomless ground through the winter - Georgie Nicholls, trainer.

runners.breeder: E A R L Ecurie Des Mottes

runners.spotlight: Unplaced in four Flat runs; has been running over hurdles recently and went very close in a Down Royal maiden hurdle in August (2m4f, good to firm); tailed off at Navan when last seen (2m, soft to heavy); makes AW debut now.

runners.comment: Dual C&D winner in 2023; three h'cap hurdle wins last summer; can go well
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner in 2023; racked up three back-to-back handicap hurdle victories last summer; below his best in two September runs when last seen; should give a good account of himself back here.

runners.comment: Gained third course win over this trip in Nov'; too keen last time; player if settling
runners.spotlight: Dour stayer gained third course win over this trip in November off 52; decent runs in defeat over 1m4f following that; ran keenly when a 8.5l sixth back over C&D in January; player if settling better.

runners.comment: His 1m4f course win came following a similar break and big player if getting this trip
runners.spotlight: 1m4f course winner in September off 13lb lower; some good efforts following that, including when left with plenty to do and running on for fifth when last seen in November (10.5f); his win came following a break and he's a big player if this new trip gets some more from him.

runners.comment: Dual hurdles winner was a decent fourth at Sligo in May; not out of it at her best
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdles winner went close over C&D in 2023; decent fourth at Sligo in May (13.5f, good); tailed off back from 292-day break in a Leopardstown mares' hurdle earlier this month; not out of it at her best.

runners.comment: M'den hurdle winner is 0-16 on the level; makes AW debut now but others preferred
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 21 starts came in an extended 2m1f maiden hurdle at Down Royal in May (good) for John and Thomas Kiely; 0-16 on the level; makes AW debut now but others preferred.

runners.comment: Last win came in 2023; placed in his last three starts; big player.
runners.spotlight: Last win came over 10.5f here in 2023 off 58; didn't race in 2024; signs of return to form in recent runs, placing in his last three starts; has shown a tendency to hang but big player upped to this trip for first time since 2022

runners.comment: Two of seven wins came over 2m in Britain; well held by several of these on recent form
runners.spotlight: Two of his seven wins came over 2m on AW in Britain; at the veteran stage now and held by several of these on recent form at this venue.

quotes.race: John B. Keane (C & G) Maiden Hurdle
quotes.quote: Desert Friend likes it around here. There wasn't much pace on, I was happy enough. He travelled and he jumped well, and he done it really well in the end. We didn't go much of a gallop which suited him down to the ground and he galloped all the way up the straight - Donagh Meyler, jockey.

racecards.verdict: Scoring over 1m4f following a similar break in September, SARMIENTO POWER is a big player if this new trip can get some more from him

runners.comment: 28,000euros foal; yard's juveniles can go well here and market worth a check
runners.spotlight: Kodi Bear filly cost 28,000euros as a foal (25,000GBP buy-back); second foal; dam French 7.5f AW winner (inc 2yo), closely related to prolific Japanese 5f-7f winner Peaceful Time, out of French 1m Group 2 winner; yard's juveniles can go well here and market worth a check.

runners.comment: 12,000euros yearling; yard's debutante juveniles always worth a market check
runners.spotlight: Earthlight filly cost 12,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to winners Kardinya (9.4f AW; RPR 72), Hopeforthefuture (Italian 5f 2yo) and Biodreina (Italian 1m 2yo); dam unraced half-sister to useful winners Khor Dubai (6f/7f) and Stormardal (1m-9.7f); yard's debutante juveniles always worth a market check.

runners.owner: P J Morgan & Mrs S L Morgan
runners.comment: Improved for switch to AW here last time when fifth; others more appealing
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; poor debut effort at Roscommon in September when tailed off (1m4f, soft); improved for switch to AW last time when an 8l fifth of 14 (10.5f); others more appealing.

runners.comment: Tailed off in two bumpers; decent fourth here in Feb' but 29l behind on turf last time
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in opening two bumper runs; decent fourth over 1m4f here in February but didn't build on that at the Curragh (1m, heavy) last time when 29l behind.

runners.comment: Went close in two January m'den runs; tailed off in h'cap last time; thereabouts at best
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced maiden went close in two January maiden runs, behind an experienced sort over 1m4f and only caught late on by a neck over 10.5f in first-time cheekpieces; something surely amiss when tailed off in a 1m4f handicap last time (reported to be post race normal); tries this shorter trip for the first time, but thereabouts at his best.

runners.comment: M'den efforts make him the one to beat; top chance if sufficiently ready
runners.spotlight: Very promising Curragh debut in 2024 when 0.5l behind subsequent Dewhurst runner-up Expanded; beaten 1l in a Gowran maiden in April last year on seasonal return (1m, yielding); decent fourth in a 1m1f Leopardstown maiden when last seen in August (good); gelded since then and top chance if sufficiently ready.

runners.comment: Placed in two 7f m'dens here before runner-up on C&D h'cap debut latest; reliable
runners.spotlight: Placed in two 7f maidens here; caught the eye when staying in late at 33-1 on debut for third and filled same position next time; second on handicap debut over C&D last time; reliable sort but a bit to find on ratings with Wild Sapphire.

runners.owner: Exors of the Late Mrs S Power
runners.comment: Outran odds when third on Curragh debut but poor next time; definite chance at best
runners.spotlight: Outran 33-1 odds on belated debut in a 7f Curragh maiden in July, missing the break and staying on nicely for third; failed to build on that at Fairyhouse next time; her Curragh run would give her a definite chance here.

runners.comment: Hasn't built on promising turf debut; well beaten over C&D last time; something to prove
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; hasn't built on promising Gowran debut when a 4.5l third of ten over a mile; well beaten over C&D last time in a new headgear combination which is now discarded; something to prove.

runners.spotlight: Four-time winner for Ed Dunlop (three on AW); won four-runner Brighton handicap last July; some encouragement in his 5.75l seventh here in February, but that is sandwiched between two poor efforts for new yard.

runners.comment: Knocking on the door here recently with multiple placed efforts; leading chance
runners.spotlight: Three course wins at 7f/1m and is now 2lb below his last winning mark from January last year; knocking on the door here recently, placing in four of his last five runs (three over C&D); took third in a higher grade last week; leading chance.

quotes.race: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap (Div I)
quotes.quote: Storm Eric works on his own at the beach and I use Jim Dreaper's gallops as well. I tip away and do it for the craic. It's great to get a day like this. He loves it here, so we'll keep coming. I have his half-sister broken and riding away, so hopefully she can win a couple of races - Jamie Flynn, trainer, speaking on Racing TV.

runners.comment: 0-16 but a handful of good efforts recently inc' when second latest; Keane rides now
runners.spotlight: Maiden is 0-16; a handful of good efforts recently including when a 1.5l second over 1m4f last time in this headgear; Colin Keane rides for the first time now; big player.

runners.comment: Won off this mark in Sept; 0.75l behind Storm Eric last time; shortlisted
runners.spotlight: Four-time course winner (three over C&D) with his last win coming in September off this mark; best of three 2026 runs came here two weeks ago when 0.75l behind Storm Eric; shortlisted.

quotes.race: Racing Again June 14th Handicap (Div I)
quotes.quote: He jumped out well, travelled well and never got hassled for the lead. Barretstown was doing an even enough gallop, took breathers when he could and kept responding. It's good when you have a willing partner like that - Billy Lee, jockey, speaking to Racing TV.

runners.comment: Last of 14 back from lengthy absence here last time; hard to fancy based on that
runners.spotlight: Two wins in Britain in 2022 came at 1m4f/1m6f on quickish ground; returned from a 578-day absence over 1m4f here last time when last of 14; hard to fancy based on that.

runners.comment: Dual 1m course winner off higher mark than this; beaten 8l over C&D when last seen
runners.spotlight: Dual course winner at 1m off higher marks than this; weakened into an 8l seventh when last seen here in January over C&D; 3lb wrong but on a dangerous mark if returning to form.
